blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Malacañang on Tuesday challenged the Philippine National Police (PNP) leadership to ensure that Senator Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa’s former position as PNP chief would not stand in the way of enforcing his arrest warrant. Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla said in a television interview last Saturday that the senator’s previous role as top cop complicated the manhunt. READ: PNP: Viral photo of Bato Dela Rosa at cemetery is ‘old’ Both dela Rosa and current PNP chief Gen. Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr. graduated from the Philippine Military Academy. “It makes it more difficult,” Remulla said on the Bilyonaryo News Channel. […]...
